**주제****:** Inquiry for noncompliance of CII rating

Dear Boris,

Good day and we hope you are doing well.

We received inquiry for noncompliance of CII rating from Korean owner as below

_Q1) if a ship is rated as D for three consecutive years or E for one year, SEEMP Part III should be reviewed and updated by inclusion of corrective actions plan._

_What are the approval criteria for the corrective action plan that must be submitted, and are there any instances where approval was not granted due to failure to meet the criteria in the past?_

We understood that minimum requirement of additional verification is stated in TNS_0165 5.3.1.3 and it will be provided as approval criteria for the corrective action plan to ship owner.

However, our office has no experiences for this case which was failure to meet criteria and please kindly advise us if you have the case which was not granted due to failure to meet.

_Q2) For ships is rated as E in 2023, the above corrective action plan must be approved in 2024 and achieve a C rating in 2025._

_If a ship fails to achieve a C rating in 2025 or fails to implement the corrective action plan (e.g., use of biofuel), what limitation may be imposed in 2026, or what actions should the shipping company take?_

We understood that it is not clear for limitation for this case of failure to the required rating and company is requested for submission of corrective action and performing additional verification same as above.

If otherwise, please kindly advise us on this matter.

Dear MO in cc,

Please kindly advise us if you have any information or additional instruction for noncompliance of CII rating.

Thank you very much.
